text: Broke, in debt, sold as a slave. One question saved him.
Dabasir spent every coin the day he got it. Soon he owed more than he could ever repay.
His wife went back to her father. He joined a band of robbers, got caught, and ended up in chains.
His master's wife, Sira, saw something in him. She asked:
Do you have the soul of a slave, or the soul of a free man?
A slave whines, "What can I do?" A free man sees problems to solve, and solves them.
He escaped, went home to Babylon, faced the men he owed, and paid back every copper.
